But this is a pure style nit with no behavioral consequence: the `|| []` branch can never trigger, and removing it changes nothing. records.issue_text: Migration interpolates host values directly into raw SQL (`INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`) without escaping or normalization, breaking on single quotes and enabling injection
records.rationale: The migration directly interpolates host values into raw SQL: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, category_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"`. Since `h` comes from the old `embeddable_hosts` site setting (admin-supplied free-form text), any value containing a single quote or SQL metacharacters would break the INSERT or inject SQL. The finding accurately describes the mechanism and it is verifiable in the diff.
